Identity coordinates; no volume rescaling. Exposed patch area 1.821924 mm². All faces supported after one contact-rim graph repair.
Material selection: surface distance ≤50 µm; face support ≤150.5 µm; 1,561 anchors excluded.

σ = −pI + µ(∇u+∇uᵀ), t = σ n_clot; n_clot = −n_fluid. No attachment face or wall reaction included. Vector glyphs drawn in foreground.
Shear arrows: 3 mm/Pa; normal arrows: 0.08 mm. Gauge pressure is tied to the original outlet reference.

PASS: frozen engineering screen. Total correction 0.7716%; shear correction 9.0150%. No reversed pressure/shear node forces.
All components conserve force and moment; near-zero torques use the disclosed physical force × length scale, not a hidden denominator.

Actual 1,927-node V3 clot. Every node retained; every seventh loaded node carries a displayed arrow for legibility.
Coordinates remain undeformed; scaled vector glyphs drawn in foreground for readability. Node forces in N; production coupling not run.

Real reference topology: M5C 2,880 nodes with saved pre-notch bonds removed; V3 1,927 material + 1,561 anchor nodes.
The V3 neighborhood diagnostic includes actual interface/anchor bonds. A boundary force under affine strain is not by itself a traction-free BC error.

Pinned perifit OSB implementation; actual source has 54 operator rows. No weight clipping, mesh cleanup, or crack restoration.
M5C kernel-preserving weighted potential passes finite differences, but this does not validate Shojaei transfer to native LPS. V3 weights fail positivity.

Computed path work agrees with global elastic energy to ~1.2×10⁻¹⁴ (scaled), while individual pair loops need not close.
M1/M2 are historical damped dynamics; their external work includes kinetic energy and numerical damping. No new fracture or calibrated Gc.
